instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: Which compound means the number of years people usually live?
questions.explanation: Life expectancy is the average number of years a person is expected to live.
questions.explanation_ar: life expectancy تعني متوسط عدد السنوات المتوقع أن يعيشها الشخص.

questions.question: A student abroad who misses home constantly is...
questions.explanation: Homesick describes the unhappy feeling of being away from home for a long time.
questions.explanation_ar: homesick تصف الشعور بالضيق عند الابتعاد عن البيت مدة طويلة.

questions.question: Someone who keeps the flat spotless and shows it off is...
questions.explanation: House-proud means taking great pride in the appearance and cleanliness of your home.
questions.explanation_ar: house-proud تعني الاعتزاز الشديد بمظهر البيت ونظافته.

questions.question: An elderly person who cannot leave the house is...
questions.explanation: Housebound means unable to go outside, usually because of illness or age.
questions.explanation_ar: housebound تعني غير قادر على الخروج من البيت، عادة بسبب المرض أو العمر.

questions.question: A party welcoming someone back after years away is a...
questions.explanation: A homecoming celebrates a person returning home after a long absence.
questions.explanation_ar: homecoming تحتفل بعودة الشخص إلى بلده بعد غياب طويل.

questions.question: A party held when people move into a new house is a...
questions.explanation: A house-warming is given by people who have just moved into a new home.
questions.explanation_ar: house-warming يقيمها من انتقلوا حديثاً إلى بيت جديد.

questions.question: Where does the stress fall in 'lifestyle'?
questions.explanation: Compound nouns carry the main stress on the first element, as in LIFEstyled speech.
questions.explanation_ar: المركّبات الاسمية تحمل النبرة الأساسية على العنصر الأول، مثل LIFESTYLE.

questions.question: How is a compound adjective usually written?
questions.explanation: Compound adjectives are written as one word or with a hyphen, never as two loose words.
questions.explanation_ar: الصفة المركّبة تُكتب كلمة واحدة أو بشرطة، ولا تُكتب كلمتين منفصلتين.

questions.question: Which word means the cleaning and tidying done at home?
questions.explanation: Housework is the routine cleaning and tidying of a house, not school tasks.
questions.explanation_ar: housework هي أعمال التنظيف والترتيب اليومية في البيت، لا الواجبات الدراسية.

questions.question: A plant grown indoors in a pot is a...
questions.explanation: The standard compound for an indoor potted plant is house plant.
questions.explanation_ar: المركّب القياسي للنبات المزروع داخل البيت في أصيص هو house plant.

questions.question: A lifelong friend is one you...
questions.explanation: Lifelong means lasting for the whole of your life.

questions.question: Home-grown vegetables are ones that are...
questions.explanation: Home-grown means produced at home rather than bought or imported.
questions.explanation_ar: home-grown تعني منتجة في البيت لا مشتراة أو مستوردة.
